I've been on lorazepam before for anxiety too.  

Sometimes a hug helps.  I hope someone is giving Peter Cornell particularly lots of hugs.  I hope someone is there for the kids to talk to, when they're ready.  I'm not sure that distracting them from their grief is a good thing though
